meta.data: committed REAL pixel-centroid F-test checkpoint (tests/fixtures/scaled/centroid.jsonl), labelled planet/blend on real TESS+Gaia data. AUC over 2-sig-fig stored p-values. Fully offline, deterministic.
meta.note: ROC/separability audit of the centroid axis: does it discriminate at ANY threshold. discoveryClaim false, safeToGate false.

verdict: P106-CENTROID-ROC (does the pixel-centroid F-test discriminate blends from planets at ANY threshold, over 114 labelled testable real sources): target-p-value AUC = 0.479 (none separation); neighbour-consistency AUC = 0.669. At the operating point p104 used (alpha=0.001) it caught 0/59 blends while wrongly rejecting 2/55 planets. The Youden-optimal cut (alpha=6.49e-1) reaches sensitivity 0.63 / specificity 0.49 (J=0.12). Conclusion: the centroid target test carries NO usable blend/planet separation on this real data at any threshold -> it cannot be promoted into the gate, confirming p104 with a full ROC rather than one operating point. discoveryClaim false, safeToGate false.
